limitations: Fixed camera-only 4+2 replay with common raw retention, Texture markers and clock method wrappers; CPU clock pairs are non-atomic, absolute counts/times descriptive only, and do not prove GPU frame identity or callback ordering. Startup sensor activity is outside observed read counts. CPU signed generation equality is not freshness or GPU completion. Retention, hashing, wrapper overhead, fresh processes and cold Mesa compilation change wall timing. Cache inventory verifies routing/population, not individual hits. Derived I420 is not a graph feed; no scientific PASS or binary equality claim.
